start: A member with the MettleUp app on Android, at the gym, scans the check-in poster's QR code

steps.action: Scan the poster with the phone camera and open the link
user_sees: The app's 'Check in at <gym>' screen opens (Android App Link)
must_not: The browser page asking to install the app

start: The same poster scanned on an Android phone without the app

user_sees: 'Check in at your gym' / 'with the MettleUp app' with the gym filled in
'Join your gym in the app, then scan the poster again.'
'No app? No problem.' 'The front desk can check you in.'
must_not: A check-in recorded with no app

start: The same poster scanned on an iPhone

user_sees: 'MettleUp is an Android app for now'
'Check in at the front desk today.'
must_not: A jump to Google Play on an iPhone

start: An old poster whose code no longer matches a gym

user_sees: 'Check in at the front desk, and ask them for a new poster.'
must_not: An error code with no words

start: The gym server could not be reached the first time, then is back

steps.action: Scan while the gym server does not answer
user_sees: 'Check your internet and scan again, or check in at the desk.'
must_not: 'This poster doesn’t match a gym' for a right poster
The failure kept and shown again for minutes

start: Anyone who photographs the poster opens its link

steps.action: Open the link from the photo
user_sees: Only the gym's public name and code
must_not: A check-in made by the link alone, from home

start: A day-pass holder with the MettleUp app on Android scans the poster

steps.action: Scan the poster and open the link
user_sees: The app opens its 'Check in at <gym>' screen; whether the pass is accepted is decided in the app (not read here)
must_not: The install page on a phone that has the app

start: A pass holder without the app scans the poster

user_sees: 'No app? No problem.' 'The front desk can check you in.'
must_not: A message that the pass holder must install the app to train

start: The pass holder scans the poster a second time the same day

user_sees: The same page or app screen as the first time; the link itself keeps nothing
must_not: A second visit recorded by the link page itself
